Notes.Text:
This update for krb5, krb5-mini fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-71199: Alteration of authentication indicators in CAMMAC container (bsc#1290192).
- CVE-2026-71200: Unauthenticated KDC NULL pointer dereference KDC DoS via crafted PKINIT pre-auth request
  (bsc#1290193).
- CVE-2026-107364: Unauthenticated KDC DoS based on ASN.1 decoder read overrun (bsc#1290029).
- CVE-2026-107778: Denial of service via crafted forwarded credentials (bsc#1284817).
- CVE-2026-107884: Unauthorized key reset of protected principal via kpasswd (bsc#1290028).
- CVE-2026-112314: MIT krb5 GSS-RPC client memory leak on XID mismatch retries (bsc#1290050).
- CVE-2026-112315: kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS in RPCSEC_GSS buffer decode failure (bsc#1290176).
- CVE-2026-112316: kadmind authenticated memory leak DoS in xdr_krb5_tl_data() decode failure (bsc#1290181).
- CVE-2026-112317: KDC unauthenticated memory leak DoS in KDB keytab key decryption error path (bsc#1290182).
- CVE-2026-112318: kadmind authenticated DoS exploiting dereference of null policy name pointers (bsc#1290183).
- CVE-2026-112319: kadmind authenticated memory exhaustion DoS via unbounded RPC XDR allocation (bsc#1290184).
- CVE-2026-112320: kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via GSS-RPC auth flavor switching (bsc#1290185).
- CVE-2026-112321: kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT error paths (bsc#1290186).
- CVE-2026-112322: kadmind unauthenticated CPU DoS via AUTH_GSSAPI client states cleanup (bsc#1290188).
- CVE-2026-112323: kadmind unauthenticated memory exhaustion via failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests (bsc#1290189).
- CVE-2026-118380: kadmind request alteration and protected information disclosure (bsc#1290190).
- CVE-2026-119079: KDC unauthenticated CPU DoS via quadratic ASN.1 SEQUENCE OF decoding (bsc#1290191).
